review_brief:
# Review: 1118c9143cae

## Built

Repaired the canonical half-turn-echo generator and added a complete native `echo_scope = all | rarest_color` family. The default program is byte-identical to canonical authority. The nondefault setting counts nonzero colors, identifies the unique rarest color, and point-reflects only cells carrying that color, preserving every original cell. Same-seed inputs are matched across settings; episodes support 2–6 demonstrations and exactly four private queries, including a substantive 30×30 case.

The base generator now has five observable, typed controls instead of dead or misleading axes. Unknown and incompatible overrides fail explicitly. Ordinary draws cover interior, boundary, and odd-grid fixed-point geometry. The task-local adapter, promotion contract, source manifest, episode validator, tests, documentation, and reusable adversarial probe are included.

## Adversarial attacks and repairs

The first passing implementation was not accepted as final. Minimum two-demo lessons were attacked with fixed color, fixed count, fixed rank, minimum/first/last/singleton/most-frequent selectors, horizontal/vertical echo, rotate-only, identity, and partial-setting rules. The initial sampler exposed two real shortcuts: color 7 was always selected and the selected count was always 2. The teaching core was repaired to cross colors 2–9, counts 2/3, and ranks 1/2 while varying geometry independently. A missing strict episode validator was also added; focused attacks now reject duplicate inputs, wrong counts, malformed grids/numeric types, stale source programs, forged labels, extra private fields, and ambiguous lessons. A final malformed-grid audit then found that rival probing could still crash after a structural error; semantic probing is now gated on a clean structural validation result, with a retained ragged-grid regression.

The final bounded probe covers 48 minimum lessons, 288 labeled pairs, and 25 rule-specific shortcuts. It reports no tested rival fitting every demonstration while changing a query. It also replays 24 representative labels through protected Racket, including both settings and the 30×30 query.

## Native and projection evidence

The source-bound authoring preflight passed four jobs (two settings × two seeds), 28 parametric pairs, all four canonical pairs, and 40 protected-Racket evaluations. A qualified `rarest_color`

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The selected color value together with the exact source-cell set carrying that color.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Count all present nonzero colors and select the unique minimum-frequency color in the current input.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Preserve the input, then point-reflect only cells whose color equals the Step-A selection to (height-1-row, width-1-col).
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Step B cannot determine which source cells or destinations to modify until Step A supplies the input-dependent selected color; replacing that value changes the echoed cell set and final grid.
